name: risly-money-manager
description: RISLY Money Manager — PWA pengelolaan keuangan pribadi dan keluarga (offline-first, vanilla JS)

scripts.lint:fix: eslint js/ sw.js tools/ tests/ eslint.config.js --fix
scripts.check:version: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const c=fs.readFileSync('js/core/config.js','utf8'); const s=fs.readFileSync('sw.js','utf8'); const cv=c.match(/version: '([^']+)'/)[1]; const sv=s.match(/VERSION = 'risly-([^']+)'/)[1]; if(cv!==sv){console.error('Versi tidak sinkron: config.js='+cv+', sw.js=risly-'+sv);process.exit(1)}console.log('Versi sinkron: '+cv);"
